operationsPolicy: The operations share covers generation and operating costs; it is not all profit. No paid quality replacements at launch.
feeChangePolicy: Contract economics are immutable per deployment; a different entry fee requires new configuration and explicit approval. At the approved 2 USDC entry, the 20 percent remainder is exactly 1.60 USDC per full tournament.
